content:
**Fireflies** are creatures found in Appalachia.

Found throughout Appalachia in small groups. Fireflies are an enlarged variant of tiny pre-War insects. Fireflies are completely non-hostile and will flee from hostile creatures. They have very few Hit Points and no means to inflict damage.

| Name (Form ID) | Abilities | Items |
| **Firefly**0026F9FE EncCritterFirefly01Template | | |

- Many spawn at Landview Lighthouse during Event: The Path to Enlightenment.
- Eight will always appear around a treehouse southwest of the Crosshair, going in the direction of WV Lumber Co.
- Many can be seen throughout the Mire and cannot be interacted with/targeted.

Fireflies are mentioned in the Pioneer Scouts entomologist exam.

Fireflies appear in *Fallout 76*.
